shortVersion: Google's Gemini 3. 7 Flash model is now accessible within GitHub Copilot, offering developers a fast and capable option for AI code assistance.
Gemini 3.7 Flash's speed-optimized design makes it attractive for high-frequency coding tasks where latency matters, further enriching Copilot's multi-model ecosystem.
